title: Taxation statistics - postcode data
notes:
Selected items for individuals, by state/territory and postcode, 1994-95 to 2022-23 income years.

Care needs to be taken when comparing data across multiple years:

For years 2010-11 onwards, the data includes a breakup by taxable status (ie taxable individuals and non-taxable individuals). 
For 2009-10 and earlier years, the data includes taxable individuals only.

resources.description: Includes counts and labels for all individuals, as well as data split between taxable and non-taxable individuals.
